== Template:Item/Vitals ==

Displays vitals, resonance and optional weapon attack stats in an item tooltip.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Default !! Description
|-
| '''health''' || 0 || Health modifier
|-
| '''mana''' || 0 || Mana modifier
|-
| '''armor''' || 0 || Armor (AC) modifier
|-
| '''res''' || 0 || Resonance modifier
|-
| '''damage''', '''delay''', '''range''' || (none) || Weapon attack stats
|}

=== Example ===

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Vitals
|health=50
|mana=25
|armor=10
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/Vitals
|health=50
|mana=25
|armor=10
}}

----

=== See Also ===

* [[Template:Item/Stats]] - Character stat modifiers
* [[Template:Item/Resists]] - Resistance percentages
